module.name: ibm_roks_cluster_cneinstall
module.description: Deploy a CNEInstance into an existing IBM ROKS cluster (after FLO is installed), using credentials from the IBM Cloud Credential Template.

required.reason: FLO must be installed first — the CNEInstance references the FLO ClusterIssuer and Trusted Profile.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to fetch cluster credentials.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID where CNEInstance will be deployed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.description: FAR Repository URL for Docker and Helm registry.

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the F5 Lifecycle Operator is installed.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where F5 utility components are installed.

optional.name: flo_cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: mTLS certificate issuer name produced by the FLO module.

optional.name: flo_trusted_profile_id
optional.description: IBM IAM Trusted Profile ID produced by the FLO module.

optional.name: cneinstance_deployment_size
optional.description: Deployment size for CNEInstance (Small, Medium, Large).

optional.name: cneinstance_network_attachments
optional.description: Multus Network Attachment Definitions for CNEInstance TMM deployments.

optional.name: cneinstance_gateway_api
optional.description: Enable Gateway API support in CNEInstance.

optional.name: cneinstance_whole_cluster
optional.description: Run CNEInstance against the whole cluster.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_pod_deployment_status
key_outputs.description: Pod deployment status after CNEInstance readiness validation.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
